title: Rin’s Lake Motosu Solo Trip
description: This is an introduction to the Yuru Camp series. Rin goes on a solo camp at Lake Motosu, which leads to her meeting Nadeshiko.

title: Fumotoppara Trip
description: Rin is supposed to do a solo camp at Fumotoppara, a campground in Fujinomiya, Shizuoka Prefecture. But she doesn’t know that Nadeshiko has followed her there.

title: Central Yamanashi Trip
description: This is the first trip for the Outdoor Exploration Club (OEC). They go to central Yamanashi and visit some places. At the same time, Rin also goes on a solo camp to the Takabotchi Highlands.

title: Lake Shibire Trip
description: The first “official” trip between Nadeshiko and Rin. They go camping at Lake Shibire, accompanied by Nadeshiko’s older sister, Sakura.

title: Rin’s Minami Alps Solo Trip
description: Rin and Nadeshiko are supposed to go on another trip, but Nadeshiko feels sick, so Rin decides to go on a solo trip around the Minami Alps. During the trip, she’s guided by Nadeshiko and Chiaki via phone.

title: Shizuoka Christmas Camp
description: The final trip of Season 1. The characters go camping in Shizuoka to celebrate Christmas.
